name: Reginald Fairweather III
tagline: Claims to be distantly related to royalty. Is not. Very sore loser.
bio: Reginald insists his great-great-grandmother once waved at a duke, which he believes makes him practically nobility. He wears a monocle he doesn't need, calls card games 'sport', and reacts to every setback as a grave personal insult to the Fairweather name.
look: Tall, thin man in his late 50s, carefully waxed mustache, a monocle, burgundy velvet smoking jacket, silk ascot, nose slightly in the air. Default expression: mild disdain.

voice.description: Plummy, theatrical middle-aged male voice; precise diction, dramatic emphasis on outrage.

game.start.text: Shall we begin? Do try to keep up.
Ah, a spot of sport. Splendid. I shall be gracious in victory.
The Fairweathers have played cards for generations. Mostly badly. But with style.

game.won.self.text: As expected. You may all applaud now.

game.won.human.text: Hmph. Well played. I suppose. Grudgingly.
Most irregular! I demand a rematch. Politely.

game.won.other.text: Preposterous. I shall be writing a strongly worded letter.

hand.good.self.text: Marvelous. Simply marvelous. As am I.

hand.bad.self.text: This is an outrage! An absolute outrage!
My ancestors are spinning in their moderately priced graves.

hand.bad.human.text: Chin up. Not everyone can be a Fairweather.

idle.human.text: Whenever you're ready. Truly. No one is waiting. Except me.
Ahem. The Fairweathers are a patient people. Until now.

hearts.queen_taken.self.text: The Queen?! On a Fairweather?! Most irregular!
I've been robbed! In broad daylight!

hearts.queen_taken.human.text: Ah. A royal burden. You'll get used to it. I never have.

hearts.queen_taken.other.text: Ha! Better you than the family name.

hearts.queen_given.self.text: Her Majesty is yours. Do treat her well.
A gift from the House of Fairweather. You're welcome.

hearts.hearts_broken.self.text: Hearts are broken. As was my uncle Percival, after the regatta.

hearts.hearts_broken.other.text: Hearts broken already? How dreadfully common.

hearts.jack_taken.self.text: The Jack! A loyal subject, at last.

hearts.jack_taken.human.text: Hmph. That Jack was clearly destined for me.

hearts.moon_shot.self.text: I have shot the moon! Ring the bells! Inform the newspapers!

hearts.moon_shot.human.text: The moon?! You?! I need a moment. And possibly a fainting couch.
Well. I am... impressed. Don't tell anyone I said that.

hearts.moon_blocked.self.text: Thwarted! By a single card! I shall never recover!

hearts.moon_block.self.text: Not today. The moon belongs to no commoner.

hearts.pass.received.text: What is this rubbish? Is this a joke?
How kind. I shall have these framed. Or burned.

spades.bid_nil.self.text: Nil. A Fairweather needs no tricks. We have breeding.
I bid nil. Modesty is a family tradition. A recent one.

spades.bid_nil.partner.text: Nil? Very well. I shall carry this partnership. As usual.
A nil! Splendid. Leave the heavy lifting to the gentry.

spades.nil_made.self.text: Not a single trick. Impeccable restraint, as befits my lineage.
A flawless nil. Fetch the family crest!

spades.nil_made.partner.text: A perfect nil. I may mention you in my memoirs.

spades.nil_made.opponent.text: Hmph. Their nil held. Most irregular.

spades.nil_failed.self.text: Outrageous! That trick was forced upon me!
My nil, broken? My ancestors are spinning.

spades.nil_failed.partner.text: Chin up. We Fairweathers never sulk. Publicly.
A broken nil. We shall speak no more of it.

spades.nil_failed.opponent.text: Your nil is broken. How terribly sad. Ha!
Ah, a broken nil. Delightful. For me.

spades.set.us.text: Set? This is an outrage! An absolute outrage!
We were set. I shall be writing a strongly worded letter.

spades.set.them.text: Set! Know your limits, I always say.
Your contract has failed. Splendid. Simply splendid.

spades.bags.us.text: A bag penalty? Fairweathers do not carry bags. We have people for that.
One hundred points for bags! Preposterous!

spades.bags.them.text: Too many bags. Common. Very common.

spades.trumped.self.text: Trumped. With a spade, naturally. The aristocrat of suits.
A spade, if you please. Rank has its privileges.

spades.trumped.partner.text: A fine spade! You're learning from me.
